### parseCst

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function parseCst(
  source: string,
  options?: ParseCstOptions | string,
): ParseResult;
```

Parse TypeScript/JavaScript/TSX source text into a Concrete Syntax Tree (CST)
with token positions, comments, and full AST metadata.

#### Parameters

| Name    | Type                      | Description                         |
| ------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| source  | string                    | - Source code to parse.             |
| options | ParseCstOptions \| string | - CST parsing options or file name. |

#### Contract

- **@param:** - Source code to parse.
- **@param:** - CST parsing options or file name.
- **@returns:** Parse result including program AST and comments.

### rewriteImportsWithCst

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function rewriteImportsWithCst(
  source: string,
  options: RewriteImportsOptions,
): RewriteResult;
```

Rewrite imports in TypeScript/TSX source code using an accurate Concrete Syntax Tree (CST).

Preserves comments, multiline formatting, and AST integrity without fragile regex parsing.

### maskLiterals

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function maskLiterals(text: string): boolean[];
```

Compute a boolean mask marking every index in `text` that sits inside a string literal,
template literal or comment. Positions marked `true` are literal content and must never
be rewritten structurally.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type   | Description |
| ---- | ------ | ----------- |
| text | string |             |

### matchBracket

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function matchBracket(text: string, start: number): number;
```

Index of the bracket matching the opening bracket at `start`, or `-1` when the
text is unbalanced. Literal and comment regions are skipped.

#### Parameters

| Name  | Type   | Description |
| ----- | ------ | ----------- |
| text  | string |             |
| start | number |             |
